title: Library: LibraryFolder missing collapsed field — expand state lost on reload
description: LibraryFolder in packages/core/src/model/types.ts (line 422) has no 'collapsed' field. The LibraryPanel (LibraryPanel.tsx line 471) tracks expand/collapse in local React state only — state resets when panel closes. Fix: (1) add 'collapsed?: boolean' to LibraryFolder in types.ts, (2) seed the LibraryPanel's expandedFolders Set from the model on mount, (3) write back to the model when folders are toggled. Also update FLA import (flash8-import.ts) to carry the collapsed field through if present.
